item.title: NetHack Remake with Gemini 4 Carbon
item.description:
Hello everyone! Today, I’d like to share my experience testing out Gemini 4 Carbon. What did I build? I remade the classic 1987 retro roguelike game NetHack into a modern 3D action RPG. The deep gameplay of the original dungeon crawler (originally rendered only in text and ASCII graphics) inspired countless games that followed, including Diablo, and thanks to its open-source nature, it continues to evolve to this day.
